groups_group_id_uuid.name: groups_group_id_uuid
groups_group_id_uuid.value:
length("groups"."group_id") = 36
    and substr("groups"."group_id", 9, 1) = '-'
    and substr("groups"."group_id", 14, 1) = '-'
    and substr("groups"."group_id", 19, 1) = '-'
    and substr("groups"."group_id", 24, 1) = '-'
    and substr("groups"."group_id", 15, 1) glob '[1-8]'
    and lower(substr("groups"."group_id", 20, 1)) glob '[89ab]'
    and length(replace("groups"."group_id", '-', '')) = 32
    and lower(replace("groups"."group_id", '-', '')) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
